title: Dedalo attribution
description: Output of `dedalo contributors --json`: what each contributor's work in the pending range is worth, before any amount is chosen.

contributions.description: Ordered by score, highest first. The order is load-bearing: `weights()` follows it, and a payout share is the weight at that index.

total_score.description: Sum of every contribution's score. Shares are computed against this, so a total of zero means an empty round rather than a division.

email.description: Identities are matched on this, not on the name: two people can share a name.

score.description: Integer milli-points, so the same history yields the same weights on every machine. Never a float.
